tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.16.34;
father of: Abiram (H0048H), Segub (H7687)
§ Hiel = "God lives"
a native of Bethel who rebuilt Jericho in the reign of Ahab and in whom was fulfilled the curse pronounced by Joshua

strongs_1890.derivation: from H2416 (חַי) and H410 (אֵל); living of God;
